figures.caption: Fig. 1. Overview of the proposed framework. Stage 1 reconstructs an enhanced volume from the degraded uLF input; the enhanced volume is concatenated with the raw input (through the operator Sα that scales gradients, α=0.3) and fed to the Stage 2 segmentation encoder-decoder. In a final stage, the hierarchical quality head is trained on embeddings from two sources: a residual encoder processes the artifact residual map (xraw − xrec), and the detached features from the segmentation encoder’s skip connections provide anatomy-aware context (gradient stopped, dashed).
Table 1. Internal validation results. Segmentation: 7 volumes; enhancement: 12 volumes; quality assessment: 106 volumes. Distances in mm; RVE is absolute relative volume error.

Fig. 2. Qualitative examples. Top (Task 1b): input, enhanced output, and residual map for a Noise=2, Zipper=1 case. Bottom (Task 2): input, reference, and predicted overlay (dashed reference boundary).
